exposure: Hypoglycemia (defined by American Academy of Pediatrics, Pediatric Endocrine Society, and neurodevelopmental studies)
cohort: The study included 62,178 premature infants with gestational age less than 34 weeks, admitted to 358 NICUs between 1997 and 2020, who had at least one culture collected and one serum glucose value recorded within the first three days of life.
finding: While hypoglycemia was not associated with overall EOS or Gram-positive EOS, a small but significant association was found between the lower AAP glucose cutoff value and EOS due to Gram-negative organisms.
